    // The eliminated right-hand side of equation j.
    SweepValue(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, j: Integer): Number
        => j <= 1
            ? self.SweepRight(1) / self.SweepDiagonal(1)
            : (self.SweepRight(j) - self.SweepBelow(j) * self.SweepValue(j - 1)) / self.SweepPivot(j);

    // The second derivative at knot j: zero at both ends (the natural condition),
    // and the back substitution in between.
    SecondDerivativeAt(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, j: Integer): Number
        => j <= 0 || j >= self.KnotCount - 1
            ? 0.0
            : (j >= self.KnotCount - 2
                ? self.SweepValue(j)
                : self.SweepValue(j) - self.SweepRatio(j) * self.SecondDerivativeAt(j + 1));

    // The index of the span containing parameter u, clamped to a real span.
    SpanContaining(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, u: Number): Integer
        => (self.KnotCount - 1).Range
            .Reduce(0, (acc, i) => self.KnotParameter(i) <= u ? i : acc)
            .Min(self.KnotCount - 2)
            .Max(0);

    // The cubic on the span containing u, written in the standard second-
    // derivative form so that both endpoint values and both endpoint curvatures
    // appear directly.
    SpanValueAt(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, u: Number): Number {
        var i = self.SpanContaining(u);
        var width = self.SpanWidth(i);
        var lower = self.SecondDerivativeAt(i);
        var upper = self.SecondDerivativeAt(i + 1);
        var toEnd = self.KnotParameter(i + 1) - u;
        var fromStart = u - self.KnotParameter(i);
        return (lower * toEnd * toEnd * toEnd + upper * fromStart * fromStart * fromStart)
                   / (6.0 * width)
             + (self.KnotValue(i) / width - lower * width / 6.0) * toEnd
             + (self.KnotValue(i + 1) / width - upper * width / 6.0) * fromStart;
    }

    // The value at the given unit parameter, mapped onto the spline's own
    // parameter domain. Outside [0, 1] the parameter clamps rather than
    // extrapolating: a natural spline is linear beyond its ends, and returning
    // that continuation silently would hide a caller's mistake.
    Eval(self: NaturalCubicSpline1D, t: Number): Number
        => self.KnotCount < 2
            ? self.KnotValue(0)
            : self.SpanValueAt(self.ParameterDomain.Lerp(t.Clamp(0.0, 1.0)));
    //==
    // # Deformation bodies for the control-point curves
    //
    // The IDeformable2D / IDeformable3D obligations of the curves in
    // `splines.types.plato`: every stored position is carried through the
    // mapping and everything else — weights, knots, degree, the shape
    // parameters, the closed flag — is untouched, because none of it is
    // geometry. Exact for an affine mapping, which commutes with each basis;
    // under a nonlinear one the result is the spline over the moved points, not
    // the image of the original curve. The Hermite types are absent on purpose
    // (see `splines.types.plato`): a tangent has no image under a point mapping.

    // Every control point carried through the mapping.
    Deform(self: BezierCurve2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): BezierCurve2D
        => BezierCurve2D(self.ControlPoints.Map(mapping));

    // Every control point carried through the mapping.
    Deform(self: BezierCurve3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): BezierCurve3D
        => BezierCurve3D(self.ControlPoints.Map(mapping));

    // Control points deformed; the weights are ratios, not positions.
    Deform(self: RationalBezierCurve2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): RationalBezierCurve2D
        => (self.ControlPoints.Map(mapping), self.Weights);

    // Control points deformed; the weights are ratios, not positions.
    Deform(self: RationalBezierCurve3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): RationalBezierCurve3D
        => (self.ControlPoints.Map(mapping), self.Weights);

    // Each segment deformed in turn; shared endpoints stay shared because the
    // same mapping sends each to the same image.
    Deform(self: CompositeBezier2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): CompositeBezier2D
        => CompositeBezier2D(self.Segments.Map(seg => seg.Deform(mapping)));

    // Each segment deformed in turn; shared endpoints stay shared.
    Deform(self: CompositeBezier3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): CompositeBezier3D
        => CompositeBezier3D(self.Segments.Map(seg => seg.Deform(mapping)));

    // Control points deformed; degree and knots are parameter-domain data.
    Deform(self: BSplineCurve2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): BSplineCurve2D
        => (self.ControlPoints.Map(mapping), self.Degree, self.Knots);

    // Control points deformed; degree and knots are parameter-domain data.
    Deform(self: BSplineCurve3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): BSplineCurve3D
        => (self.ControlPoints.Map(mapping), self.Degree, self.Knots);

    // Control points deformed; weights, degree and knots unchanged.
    Deform(self: NurbsCurve2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): NurbsCurve2D
        => (self.ControlPoints.Map(mapping), self.Weights, self.Degree, self.Knots);

    // Control points deformed; weights, degree and knots unchanged.
    Deform(self: NurbsCurve3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): NurbsCurve3D
        => (self.ControlPoints.Map(mapping), self.Weights, self.Degree, self.Knots);

    // Interpolated points deformed; Alpha selects the parameterization, not a
    // position, so it survives.
    Deform(self: CatmullRomCurve2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): CatmullRomCurve2D
        => (self.Points.Map(mapping), self.Alpha, self.Closed);

    // Interpolated points deformed; Alpha and the closed flag unchanged.
    Deform(self: CatmullRomCurve3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): CatmullRomCurve3D
        => (self.Points.Map(mapping), self.Alpha, self.Closed);

    // Knot points deformed; the per-knot tension, continuity and bias shape the
    // tangents and carry no position of their own.
    Deform(self: TcbSpline2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): TcbSpline2D
        => (self.Points.Map(mapping), self.Tensions, self.Continuities, self.Biases, self.Closed);

    // Knot points deformed; the TCB parameters unchanged.
    Deform(self: TcbSpline3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): TcbSpline3D
        => (self.Points.Map(mapping), self.Tensions, self.Continuities, self.Biases, self.Closed);

    // Every point carried through the mapping; a piecewise-linear spline is the
    // one member of this family whose deformed form IS the image of the curve
    // whenever the mapping is affine.
    Deform(self: LinearSpline2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): LinearSpline2D
        => (self.Points.Map(mapping), self.Closed);

    // Every point carried through the mapping.
    Deform(self: LinearSpline3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): LinearSpline3D
        => (self.Points.Map(mapping), self.Closed);
}
